We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: a pharmaceutical sales person (or representative) bribing hospital staff (charging fees) to increase drug sales. This is typical "行贿" (bribery) and "受贿" is for officials receiving bribes. Here the defendant is the briber (邓某) who gives money to hospital staff (刘某, 杨某) who then pass to doctors. So the crime is "行贿" (giving bribes). Also possibly "非法经营" but main is "行贿". Also "组织、领导、介绍他人受贿" maybe? The defendant is organizing bribery. In Chinese criminal law, "行贿罪" (bribery) applies to giving bribes to state functionaries, but medical staff are public employees (hospital staff) considered state functionaries? They are public institution employees, so yes. So the crime is "行贿". Also maybe "非法经营" not. The examples: earlier similar case (金某) was "行贿". So answer: 行贿.

Thus output format: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
